subtests.name: Window performs three rewrites and dispatches through one compiled matmul/add/ReLU graph
Dedicated Worker runs the same numerical graph in its own CPU context
CPU opt-in follows the pinned WebIDL dictionary and ignores unknown fields
Builder ownership, aliasing, dimensions, buffer type and destroyed resources are enforced
Destroying a constant tensor before graph compilation invalidates its operand
Support reporting reflects implemented CPU kernels and returns fresh dictionaries
